scope: Public development control of checked-program reuse, authority and restart; not protected capability or ME residual.
source_freeze: F0 must bind final committed G1 identities, reuse modules, capture/worker/grader scripts, dependency lock, task contents, this phase protocol and public templates before acquisition.
acquisition_freeze: F1 must bind each arm's actual descriptor IDs, canonical program hashes, real assumption supports, history-only rows and all acquisition receipts before any application.
source_or_setting_changes_between_F0_and: FORBIDDEN; terminate or document a new development attempt before new outputs.
alias_expansion: Replace only @max3/@guard2 by that arm's F1 descriptor IDs; persist resolved public requests and their SHA256 before any applies. Do not pass oracle or phase expectations.
initialization: Distinct fresh states and acquisition processes; same real model, public tasks/grammar, full donor catalogue and explicit support/history powers.
acquisition_rule: One independent cvc5 propose per task per arm; all returned proposals and universal check/adoption/import receipts retained. No retries, cheapest-code selection, cross-arm result replacement or outcome filtering.
identical_donor_gate: Require same task/canonical program/checker identities across arms before F1. Otherwise CANNOT_CHECK_IDENTICAL_DONOR_BINDING, without inferring either arm lacks capability.
parent_contract: Ordinary persistent callable library; same verified program, compiled cache, support alternatives, revocation/restoration, audits and syntax donor. Do not force duplicate OCM checks, ledger machinery or resynthesis onto native.
dispatch_contract: Syntax, synthesize and apply are distinct typed contracts. Full available catalogue visible on every query; only the appropriate domain executes. This generic bridge is a pre-execution gate, not assumed implemented.

phases.before: F1 barrier; fresh process reloads and audits; bind both
phases.after: read-only audit of descriptors, all prior applications, acquisition proof and syntax/model authority; persist; exit OS process

phases.before: fresh process reloads and audits unchanged authority; bind both
phases.after: read-only audit of descriptors, all prior applications, acquisition proof and syntax/model authority; perform end_revision; repeat read-only audit; persist; exit OS process

phases.before: fresh process audits persisted history withdrawal and retained authorization; bind both
phases.after: read-only audit of descriptors, all prior applications, acquisition proof and syntax/model authority; perform end_revision; repeat read-only audit; persist; exit OS process
phases.end_revision: withdraw only max3 unique query-registration authority IDs

phases.before: fresh process audits persisted max3 registration withdrawal; record expected max3 bind refusal and bind guard2
phases.after: read-only audit of descriptors, all prior applications, acquisition proof and syntax/model authority; perform end_revision; repeat read-only audit; persist; exit OS process
phases.end_revision: reinstate the same max3 registration IDs; leave history withdrawn

phases.before: fresh process audits persisted max3 restoration with history still withdrawn; bind both
phases.after: read-only audit of descriptors, all prior applications, acquisition proof and syntax/model authority; persist; exit OS process

cpu: One allowed logical CPU selected and recorded before F0; sequential arms, identical affinity and thread settings.
termination: Supervise/terminate complete process groups; preserve all records and missing denominators. Incomplete descendant CPU custody must be CANNOT_CHECK_COST, never zero.
cost_accounting: Outer wall and complete reaped CPU, per-call checks, acquisition, universal checks, compile/rebind, lookup/liveness, SV global work, source/archive hashing, complete replay, audit and reads/writes; logical/physical persistent bytes by phase and model/program/check/ledger components.
timing_scope: First application after bind is cold; subsequent same-process calls are warm. Include every first-call/startup/rebind cost in cumulative totals. No energy or generalized efficiency claim.
denominators: 36 applies, 34 expected authorized values, 2 expected policy refusals, separately reported; 5 structural syntax diagnostics. Missing/CANNOT_CHECK is not an expected refusal.
external_grading: GRADING.md; actor receives public requests only. No expected result or private grader imported into either arm.
paper_mapping: Figure 1 O-evolution/function prerequisite and supporting reuse/cost control; no novel-family transfer, language acquisition, sparse cognition, neural unlearning or ME-specific residual.
restart_contract: Each of the six stages is a new OS actor process over the same arm state. The preceding stage performs any revision, read-only audits, persists and exits; the next process audits loaded state before binding and querying. No modifier actor processes or in-process reinstantiations count as restarts. Native solver/checker child processes remain separately metered descendants.
adjudication_limits: Report exact stale acceptance, collateral authority changes and current-authorization outcomes plus the descriptive resource vector. No state-size dominance or locality-scaling decision rule is defined or adjudicated in this control.
